name: Maharashtra Corporation Limited
about: Maharashtra Corporation Limited engages in investing, trading, and distributing textile products, commodities, and goods in India. The cpmpany's products include gunnies, handicrafts, hessian, tea, shellac, tobacco, hides, skins, kapocks, cotton, cotton goods, myrobalan, nux, indigo, oils, oilcakes, fertilizers, manure, rubber, dates, rice, seeds, chemicals, colour, paints, pigments, timber, iron, steel, carpets, and other related products. It also engages in the real estate business. The company was formerly known as Maharashtra Overseas Limited and changed its name to Maharashtra Corporation Limited in March 2011. Maharashtra Corporation Limited was incorporated in 1982 and is based in Mumbai, India.
